Name: Edge Guard
Author: jaericknexus
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Avoid accidentally harvesting your infinite grass! Prevents grass planted underneath a fence post from being harvested.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52353/52353-1789577286-379460157.gif[/img]

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Unzip to Stardew's Mods folder

[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*]Makes grass planted underneath a fence post, lightning rod, or garden pot un-harvestable[/*]
[*]Works for any action that would destroy the grass - scythe, bladed weapon, or bombs[/*]
[*]Allows grass placement underneath existing items [/*]
[*]Optional toggle for protecting grass underneath any player-placed item[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
Optional in-game menu compatibility with GMCM

Manifest.Name: Edge Guard
Manifest.Description: Stops grass planted under a fence, lightning rod, Garden Pot, or (optionally) any placed item from being accidentally cut by a scythe, melee weapon, or bomb.
